content: Project available at https://github.com/kimihiro64/erdos-690-prime-factor-unimodality. It's a fairly significant reworking of the Wang-Crapis paper to eliminate costly finite certificates, although it still relies on multiple github runs and re-used .oleans to get a passing build because of large twin gap records, so it's not ideal for submission to Palomar. It also still has one conditional input from Dusart, which so far seems simply infeasible, mostly due to the prohibitive cost of zeta zero verification, though I'm actively looking at ways to work around that without resorting to native_decide or anything like that.
